summary: Kaggle VLM re-extraction pass: 444/444 claims failed with CUDA out of memory.
root_cause: Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct loaded in 4-bit (~5GB weights) + full-page 200 DPI rasterized images (large image-token counts) + default eager attention blew past the T4 16GB limit (tried allocating 22.9-23.4 GiB). Model choice was oversized for the task; the vision processor had no max_pixels cap and pages were not downscaled.
